brand.name: Guide Visa
brand.slogan: Votre chemin vers l'étranger, sans arnaque.

component_patterns.cards: Flat white background (bg-white), rounded-2xl, very subtle border (border border-slate-100), ambient shadow. Generous padding (p-6).
component_patterns.buttons: Primary uses Bleu Marine (#0A3D62) with white text. CTA/Action uses Jaune Doré (#F9CA24) with dark text. Apply scale-95 on active press.
component_patterns.forms: Soft background for inputs (bg-[#F5F7FA]), border-transparent, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A3D62]. Labels left-aligned, text-sm font-semibold.
component_patterns.cost_display: Flex container showcasing dual currencies. Local currency (XOF/FCFA) is dominant (text-2xl font-bold text-[#1A2B4C]). Target official currency (CAD/EUR) is a smaller pill badge beside it (text-xs bg-slate-100 px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-slate-600).
component_patterns.step_timeline: Vertical layout for simulator steps. Left column features a 2px vertical line with circular numbered nodes (active = green/yellow, inactive = gray). Right column contains the expandable step details card.
component_patterns.eligibility_gauge: Animated circular SVG progress gauge. Color logic: <50 is danger red (#E74C3C), 50-74 is yellow (#F9CA24), >=75 is green (#2ECC71). Large numeric score centered with ' /100' subtitle.
component_patterns.trust_signals_anti_scam: Prominent inline alert cards (bg-red-50 text-red-900 border border-red-200) placed near high-friction actions (payments, official links). Uses ShieldAlert icon.
component_patterns.bottom_tab_bar: Fixed to bottom, z-50. Glassmorphism surface. 5 items: Home, Docs, Forum, Links, Profile. Active items get primary color icon/label.

screen_layouts.name: 1. Landing / Onboarding (3 slides)
screen_layouts.layout: Full viewport height carousel. Background image with bg-black/40 overlay. Bottom 45% is a white rounded-t-3xl bottom-sheet card containing Title, Subtitle, pagination dots, and Primary CTA 'Commencer'. Image changes per slide.

screen_layouts.name: 2. Login / Register
screen_layouts.layout: Centered form on #F5F7FA background. Logo at top. Country dropdown uses flag icons next to names. Clear toggle between Login/Register.

screen_layouts.name: 3. Dashboard / Home
screen_layouts.layout: Top sticky nav with Avatar/Name. Yellow hero banner 'Lancer une simulation'. Grid (grid-cols-2 gap-4 on mobile) of country cards (Canada, France, Germany) with photos. Bottom tab bar.

screen_layouts.name: 4. Simulator Flow - Motif
screen_layouts.layout: Step 1/3 of wizard. Top progress bar. Grid of large radio-cards (Student, Worker, Family). Selected card gets 2px primary border.

screen_layouts.name: 5. Simulator Flow - Profile Form
screen_layouts.layout: Step 2/3 of wizard. Multi-step form inputs (Age, Education, Language). Clean, vertical stacking.

screen_layouts.name: 6. Simulator Flow - Eligibility Score
screen_layouts.layout: Step 3/3 of wizard. Centered circular gauge animating to final score. Text analysis below it. Primary CTA 'Voir les étapes'.

screen_layouts.name: 7. Simulation Detail (7 steps)
screen_layouts.layout: Vertical timeline. Each step is an accordion card showing step costs (dual currency XOF + CAD/EUR), time estimates, official links, and an embedded anti-scam alert card.

screen_layouts.name: 8. Digital Document Safe - Categories
screen_layouts.layout: Grid of folder cards (Identity, Finances, Education). Top global progress bar 'Dossier complété 40%'.

screen_layouts.name: 9. Digital Document Safe - Upload
screen_layouts.layout: Checklist of documents. Dashed-border drag-and-drop zone. Uploaded files show lucide file icon and 'verified' green checkmark.

screen_layouts.name: 10. Useful Links Library
screen_layouts.layout: Horizontal scrollable pill filters (14 categories). Vertical list of link cards. Each card has a subtle 'Official' blue badge and external-link icon.

screen_layouts.name: 11. Forum Community - Home
screen_layouts.layout: Search bar. Sticky horizontal category tabs. Vertical list of topics showing title, author avatar/badge, reply count.

screen_layouts.name: 12. Forum Community - Topic Detail
screen_layouts.layout: Original post at top. List of replies below. Sticky bottom container with input field for quick reply.

screen_layouts.name: 13. User Profile
screen_layouts.layout: Avatar header. Settings list (Currency preference toggle XOF/XAF/EUR, Offline mode toggle, Notifications). Logout button.

screen_layouts.name: 14. Anti-scam Alert Cards
screen_layouts.layout: Grid of red-tinted alert cards detailing common scams (Fake agents, Guaranteed visas). Actionable 'Signaler une arnaque' button.

screen_layouts.name: 15. Admin Dashboard
screen_layouts.layout: Desktop-first layout. Left sidebar nav. Grid-cols-4 for KPI stats. Data table for Users CRUD and Links CRUD.

motion_microinteractions.page_transitions: Slide-in from right for new mobile screens to mimic native apps.
motion_microinteractions.hover_states: Interactive cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with increased shadow. Buttons scale down to 95% on click.
motion_microinteractions.gauge_animation: Animate SVG stroke-dashoffset from 0 to score over 1.5 seconds with ease-out.
motion_microinteractions.toasts: Use Sonner for non-blocking success/error notifications (e.g., Doc uploaded, Offline mode activated).

hero_onboarding_1.description: Joyful African woman with passport, ready for trip. Use for Slide 1 or Hero.

onboarding_student.description: African student with passport at airport terminal. Use for Slide 2.

onboarding_professional.description: Young African professional working on laptop. Use for Slide 3.

onboarding_family.description: Happy African family. Use for family motif selection.

icons.instructions: Use ShieldAlert for scams, CheckCircle2 for validation, Landmark for official links. 24px width, stroke 2.

accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-form-submit-button').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure white text on #0A3D62 and dark text on #F9CA24 meet WCAG AA.
accessibility_and_testing.offline_mode: Show a visible but non-intrusive 'Mode Hors Ligne' indicator in the app header when network drops.

tech_stack.frontend: React JS (.js/.jsx), TailwindCSS, Shadcn UI primitives, Framer Motion.
tech_stack.note: Project uses JavaScript, NOT TypeScript. Do not include TS interfaces or types.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs and bottom bars.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap. Mobile PWA needs ample touch targets.
Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Always use Unsplash URLs provided.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background.
